what_changed: CFPB rule treating overdraft credit from very large financial institutions as credit under Regulations Z and E unless the fee only recovers costs (new 12 CFR 1026.62; conforming changes to 1005.10(e)(1) comment and 1026.1-1026.4, 1026.42, 1026.60).
rationale: Overdraft credit on deposit accounts, excluded by the relevance test. The Reg E 1005.10(e)(1) change only extends the compulsory-use rule to covered overdraft credit, not to other consumer loans. Stage A: title, abstract, metadata and eCFR diff excerpt only; full text not read.
